description: Hand-labeled Fastify endpoint-authentication cases for the semantic Endpoint adapter. probable = the guard truly applies to the route from the source; ambiguous = the source does not establish the binding.

cases.label: probable
cases.rationale: addHook precedes the route in the same plugin, so onRequest checkToken applies to GET /api/orders/orders. Declaration order now decides this deterministically; the label checks that the binding is established.

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.rationale: addHook follows the route, so it does not cover GET /api/orders/orders and no guard binding may be proposed. Declaration order decides this deterministically.

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.rationale: Two registrations serve GET /api/orders/orders; only the guarded one has a guard. The server cannot be shown to serve the guarded one.

cases.label: ambiguous
cases.rationale: checkToken is defined by two verifiers. Neither definition can be chosen from the evidence.
